A5_S1_D1: ^Narrator: Hours have flown by since you busied yourself with the humans’ artifact collection. Amelia has wandered off elsewhere, claiming she had something to attend to.
^Narrator: From diary entries like the one you found to trinkets… it’s amazing how much has been found and maintained.
^Noelle: (Now for this box I’ve been hearing about.)
^Narrator: Indeed it is made of metal, but you recognize the way the key opening and indents on the sides are shaped.
^Narrator: …This style of box is one of the first things your mother taught you about.
^Narrator: They’re used by high-ranking elders on Dusk to keep heirlooms and wills.
^Noelle: (Which means that one of our ancestors was definitely…!)
^Narrator: The box pops open. Your heart skips a beat.
^Noelle: A pendant from the Tempest clan.
^Narrator: Your mind races. Could it be true then, that Noah is—?
^Narrator: Cillian sorts through the other items in the box. A compass that no longer works, a couple of entries in two different fonts.
^Cillian: This is Elio and Noah’s penmanship.
^Noelle: So they locked away their keepsakes together?
^Cillian: It’s not the most surprising. Regardless of what one thinks the nature of their relationship was, there was no doubt they were sworn partners.
^Noelle: …On my island, we use these kinds of locks for the heads of important families.
^Narrator: You gulp, unsure of how Cillian might take this.
^Noelle: And the engraving is the same as my clan’s.
^Narrator: You can almost hear the cogs turning in Cillian’s head.
^Cillian: …It is probably best that you do not disclose your ties to this, moving forward.

^Cillian: We cannot be sure whether the pendant is Noah’s or Elio’s — but what’s important is that some may still hold ill-will towards those figures. So I will need some time to think before reporting what this box is about.
^Narrator: Cillian does his best to quirk a smile.
^Cillian: Regardless of politics, you have helped us greatly by opening this.
^Cillian: If your goal is still to fix up your boat, you may try approaching our head weaver, Rowan, for fabric to make a sail.
^Cillian: Tell him I sent you. Clara can show you the way.
A5_S1_D2: ^Narrator: Amelia has rejoined you, seeming a little more distracted than usual.
^Amelia: Just… went by a spot that I used to frequent, when I was young.
